derived_theorem_hazards.finding: Zero-Pochhammer radial derivatives can otherwise form 0*nonfinite.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Exact zero shortcut proved; implementation checked by G4.

derived_theorem_hazards.finding: A rectangle radius max(rx,ry) is too small for a complex modulus disk.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Use outward sqrt(rx²+ry²); exact 3,4,5 and 1,1 corner tests.

derived_theorem_hazards.finding: Subtracting separate upper bounds W-S need not upper-bound interior mass.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Evaluate independent J bound; synthetic counterexample.

derived_theorem_hazards.finding: Complex Gaussian completion with |r1-r2|^k cannot be justified by a naive spatial contour shift.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Parameter analytic continuation from real Gaussian moments, with common compact domination.

derived_theorem_hazards.finding: Exact v does not make host-rounded tau or historical rounded normalization the exact continuous target.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Exact quotient tau=z/v and outward ideal normalization; keep stored pref/C bits.

derived_theorem_hazards.finding: Uniform inner parameter width can prevent tolerance convergence even for a valid inclusion.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Treat as valid-wide/resource feasibility, cap work, use a justified alternative.

derived_theorem_hazards.finding: Binary64 comparator tolerance and real decimal 1e-10 are distinct exact numbers.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Record comparator exact bits and separate real-rule sufficiency from machine-predicate audit.

derived_theorem_hazards.finding: Wide reciprocal/variance ball can fail a branch guard although every exact target point has Re(sigma)>0.
derived_theorem_hazards.resolution: Refine enclosure/subdivide/prove a sharper domain bound; never midpoint-admit the box.
